en.html:
《Life or death: I ask myself the question I must answer.》
《Then raise the curtain of comedy upon the delighted whirlpool of mockery.》

《The dog howling through the storm-night fights the foolish thief with courage.》
《The chick waiting in its warm nest for its parent sleeps peacefully inside the serpent.》
《The lion born in dappled sunlight eats its fill of thousands of deer.》
《The frog eggs listening to the brook are gathered by a child and crushed underfoot.》
《You who believe in life's meaning, hear the clown's most sincere dishonesty.》
《You who tremble before death, the devil's mask is a mirror painted black.》
《Question life, and clown and devil arrive carrying spoons.》
《Trust life and drown in it, and clown and devil remove their crowns.》
《O beast, dance! Run the fields! Sing, shout, rage and roam!》
《Every chain and every cage before you is now only crumbling mud.》
